title: Autonomous Science Bench: Evaluating AI Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.18449v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents for autonomous scientific discovery must decide which experiments to run under a limited budget. Most benchmarks for science agents provide fixed datasets, while others that support active experimentation largely rely on simulation. We introduce Autonomous Science Bench, an initial release comprising six budgeted design-build-test-learn campaigns grounded in published experiments across biology, chemistry, and materials science. Agents select batches of designs, receive measurements from a lab service, and use the results to guide subsequent experiments before delivering a predictive model. Success requires passing two calibrated gates: a discovery gate, which evaluates the designs the agent measured, and a learning gate, which evaluates its model's ranking of held-out designs. translated_title: 自主科学基准：评估用于自主科学发现的AI智能体
translated_abstract: 用于自主科学发现的AI智能体必须在有限预算下决定进行哪些实验。大多数面向科学智能体的基准只提供固定数据集，而其他支持主动实验的基准则主要依赖仿真。我们推出了自主科学基准的首个版本，包含六个有预算约束的设计-构建-测试-学习活动，这些活动均基于已发表的生物学、化学和材料科学实验。智能体选择设计批次，从实验室服务获取测量结果，并利用这些结果指导后续实验，最终交付一个预测模型。成功需要通过两个经过校准的关卡：发现关卡，用于评估智能体所测量的设计；学习关卡，用于评估其模型对保留设计集合的排序能力。在包含八种智能体-模型配置和144次试验的试点评估中，最佳配置在67%的试验中取得成功，而最难的活动（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个基于真实已发表实验的自主科学发现评测基准，通过预算受限的设计-构建-测试-学习活动以及发现与学习双重校准关卡，系统评估AI智能体在有限实验预算下进行科学决策与建模的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Autonomous Science Bench, a benchmark grounded in real published experiments across biology, chemistry, and materials science that evaluates AI agents for autonomous scientific discovery through budgeted design-build-test-learn campaigns with calibrated discovery and learning gates.
